safe_source_headers.title: FPP chi=1/3 campaign, 2026-08-12 fire 93 (MONOTONICITY_PROBE_20260812.md): variance monotonicity Var(X_{n+1}) >= Var(X_n) for planar FPP reduces exactly to a signed-covariance statement via the identity Var(X_{n+1}) - Var(X_n) = Cov(X_{n+1} + X_n, Delta), Delta := X_{n+1} - X_n bounded by an O(1) triangle bound. FKG/Harris positive association is structurally inapplicable: Delta is not environment-monotone (two-route gadget, verified by construction - raising a weight on X_n's geodesics only makes Delta strictly fall). The known conditional proof of the MEAN's monotonicity (S_+ <= 2 S_- support condition, arXiv 1202.2665) works precisely because that condition kills the rerouting gadget, so the natural variance attack is conditional of the same shape. Status: open, obstruction named; genuinely separate from the wall-equivalent doubling sub-problem.

FPP chi=1/3 campaign, 2026-08-15 fire 5: rho_n = Q_n^2/D_n is NOT a target of the reduced engine, and the first measurement of (L2'). TARGET-MAP CORRECTION: CRUX 9.2's consequence reads verbatim 'Under (L1)+(L2), CONSTANT-strength chaos delivers the halving. No envelope, no fluctuation-scale concentration, no value of chi is used anywhere', and 9.3 calls section 2's eps <~ log^4 n/n^2 'an artifact of routing the fourth moment through a lossy envelope, not an intrinsic demand of the engine', with 'the wall persists INSIDE (L1)'. So the honest ledger is 9.5's: (L1') is THE WALL, (L2') a scale-free shape condition, (L3) worth exactly one power of n, and eps <= 1/(16 kappa4 beta^2 C_occ) is a CONSTANT. This confirms rather than disturbs the campaign's other 08-15 findings - the fire-1 ratio R = D_Mn/D_n, fire-3's constant-A doubling and (L1') are one object. It STRIKES two of my own sentences: 'the wall is rho alone' (fire 2) and 'the remaining target is rho = O(1), i.e. H1+H3' (fire 4). FIRST MEASUREMENT OF (L2'), the one reduction condition that is not the wall and that nobody had examined; it is scale-free, which is why a small lattice can speak to it at all. U[1,2] on Z^2, exact Dijkstra, zero boundary escapes: axis-block conditional kurtosis medians 2.886/2.973/2.927 at N=16/24/32, flat, at the Gaussian value; power diagnostic shows m4 bulk-carried (top-1 share of sum d^4 only 0.015-0.035, bootstrap 5-95% inside [2.72,3.22]). DEFLATED BY ITS OWN ARTIFACT TEST: rerouting is common and rising (fraction 0.170 at occupation 3.94 edges to 0.388 at 6.04, carrying 15-36 pct of E[Delta^2], kappa4 = 3.02 within the rerouted subpopulation) so it is not a pure no-reroute CLT - but the geodesic spends only 4 to 6 EDGES inside these blocks, and a fixed-length sum of L iid uniforms has kurtosis exactly 3 - (6/5)/L (2.70 at L=4, 2.80 at L=6), so every measured value sits within ~0.1-0.2 of trivial arithmetic. CONCLUSION: (L2') is NOT refuted (a refutation would have killed the 9.5 reduction outright) and is NOT supported either at this block size. RECORDED TRAP: kappa4 ~ 3 invites '(L2') follows from a CLT', but convergence in distribution gives fourth-moment convergence only under uniform integrability of Delta^4, which IS the tail control (L2') asks for - the CLT renames the difficulty. NEXT: bigger blocks before more reps; then the engine's aspect ratio W ~ sqrt(nQ); then 10x conditional samples on one axis block. chi = 1/3 UNMOVED.

FPP chi=1/3 campaign - CORRECTED 2026-08-22 by lane P3's referee pass; supersedes the 2026-08-12 fire-93 row (MONOTONICITY_PROBE_20260812.md) and restates it whole. THE STATUS LINE CHANGED, THE MATHEMATICS DID NOT. Corrected status: variance monotonicity is OFF this campaign's target list since fire 4 (2026-08-15) - it has no consumer here, giving R_n >= 1 where every consumer needs the upper bound, only a constant variance floor where c log n is already unconditional, and a window that still diverges - and the doubling sub-problem it was being contrasted with is a reformulation of the wall only in the qualified sense: constant-A doubling delivers beta = O(1) at the blocks the geodesic meets with probability of order one, not everywhere, and "wall-equivalent" is not an exact biconditional. Monotonicity is still open, still interesting mathematics, and open even for the mean; it just buys this program nothing. THE PROBE'S CONTENT, CONFIRMED BY P3 AND UNCHANGED: monotonicity Var(X_{n+1}) >= Var(X_n) for planar FPP reduces exactly to a signed-covariance statement through the identity Var(X_{n+1}) - Var(X_n) = Cov(X_{n+1} + X_n, Delta) with Delta := X_{n+1} - X_n bounded by an O(1) triangle bound, equivalently monotonicity iff Cov(X_n, Delta) >= -Var(Delta)/2; and FKG/Harris positive association is structurally inapplicable, because Delta is not environment-monotone - the two-route gadget is constructible with bounded weights and raising a weight on X_n's geodesic makes Delta strictly fall. That is an obstruction to Harris, not a proof that no positive-association argument exists. ONE CAVEAT P3 ADDED: the known conditional proof of the MEAN's monotonicity (Gouere, arXiv 1202.2665) was confirmed at ABSTRACT level only - expected passage time increasing under a strong support condition - and the exact form S_+ <= 2 S_- was never checked against that paper's body, so its use here is motivational. chi = 1/3 UNMOVED.
The fibre is an Ising partition function

metadata.proof_text: Integrate out the private (unshared) coordinates triangle by triangle: a triangle with 3 private coordinates contributes a constant factor 3/4; one with 2 private coordinates contributes a constant independent of its shared coordinate (this is exactly why trees have c = 0); one with 1 private coordinate contributes (3/2)(1 - x_u x_v/3) on its shared pair; one with 0 private coordinates contributes (3/4)(1 - (uv+vw+uw)/3). Expanding the product over edges and averaging, every selection with a vertex of odd degree vanishes, leaving the even-selection sum. Machine-checked: 1,200 random linear systems across three seeds, exact rational arithmetic, 1,200 matches / 0 mismatches, covering all four triangle types, plus 12/12 structured attack shapes (K4, theta graphs, chorded cycles) and 13/13 additivity shapes (campaign 2026-08-20).
